title: Retail Cancellation Refund Figure — Kessler Care Essentials, Plus and Premium
content:
**Refund clause.** The retail cancellation refund on a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans Essentials, Plus or Premium plan starts from the retail-value amount. That amount is the purchase price less the plan's retail value per visit for each visit used, where visits used are visits redeemed less visits reinstated. The retail cancellation fee, which is the plan's cancellation fee, is deducted from it.

**Combination clause.** The fee and any deductions that apply are subtracted from the refund amount, and credits that apply are added to it. The retail cancellation refund is rounded half up to the cent and floored at 0.00 at the end. A free look or unwound-deal refund replaces the whole computation:
- **Free look:** the plan is cancelled within its free look period of calendar days after the sale date, with no visit used.
- **Unwound deal:** the plan was sold on a Vehicle Purchase Agreements deal that now stands unwound.

In either of those cases the refund is the full purchase price.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)
| Inputs | Refund |
|---|---|
| Price 480.00; retail value 95.00; 2 used, 1 of them reinstated (1 used); fee 45.00 | 480.00 less 95.00 less 45.00 is 340.00 |
| Price 260.00; retail value 95.00; 3 used; fee 45.00 | 260.00 less 285.00 less 45.00 is minus 70.00, floored to 0.00 |
| Price 480.00; cancelled inside the free look; none used | 480.00 |
